name: Odamex Party
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y cmake ninja-build libsdl2-dev libsdl2-mixer-dev libsdl2-net-dev zlib1g-dev libpng-dev unzip && git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/odamex/odamex.git ~/odamex && cd ~/odamex && git checkout 12.3.0 && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && ninja && cd client && wget https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom/releases/download/v0.13.0/freedoom-0.13.0.zip && unzip -j freedoom-0.13.0.zip '*/freedoom2.wad' && cp freedoom2.wad ../server/
